svg.title: Position, velocity and acceleration of the subway train
svg.desc: The train speeds up at 0.417 m/s² for 20 s to 8.33 m/s (30 km/h), travels at constant velocity until 40 s, then slows at −1.04 m/s² and stops at 48 s, about 283 m from its start. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: One clock drives the train and all three graphs
Subway train: 0 to 30 km/h in 20 s, cruise to 40 s, stop at 48 s. The slope of each graph is the
value plotted on the next one.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
